name: Walter Holt

goals.text: a son to take on the trade

memories: Word came from Sunspire: The Ward family loads a cart and leaves Sunspire for Highcrag.
They say in the market: Famine in Saltkeep.
They say in the market: Famine in Rainhold.
They say in the market: The fields round King's Crag, Windcross, Gildport and 16 more give out: sown too many years running, they bear thin and weedy, and will for a while yet.
Word came from Redsands: Famine in Redsands.
They say in the market: Famine in Stormwatch.
